definitions.gloss: long distance; long range; far away
definitions.explanation: A great physical distance between two places. Used for commuting, relationships, travel, and also in military/technical contexts for range.

examples.japanese: {遠距離|えんきょり}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{堪|こた}える→堪える：30446_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: A long commute takes a toll on the body.

examples.japanese: {遠距離|えんきょり}{恋愛|れんあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I've been in a long-distance relationship for three years.

examples.japanese: {遠距離|えんきょり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{鮮明|せんめい}→鮮明：14686_senmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}できる→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A camera was developed that can take clear photos from a long distance.

notes:
A compound of {遠|えん} (far) and ⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (distance). The opposite is ⟦{近距離|きんきょり}→近距離：19019_kinkyori⟧ (short distance).

Very commonly used as a modifier before other nouns.

COMPOUNDS:
- {遠距離|えんきょり}{恋愛|れんあい} (long-distance relationship, often abbreviated as {遠|えん}キョリ or {遠恋|えんれん})
- {遠距離|えんきょり}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (long commute)
- {遠距離|えんきょり}⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧ (commuting a long distance to school)
- {遠距離|えんきょり}⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧ (long-range attack)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧ also means 'long distance' but is more commonly used for races and transportation (e.g., ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧)
